title: Zalce jailed five days by the Mexican Navy

tellings.quote: I spent around 5 days in jail because they they said I I was a liar and I was putting in risk the honorability of of the whole system of the Navy.

plain: Sometime in the 2020s, a man named Jose Zalce says, the Mexican Navy put him in jail for about five days. He tells Michels they called him a liar and said he was "putting in risk the honorability" of the whole Navy, which would mean he was punished for speaking out, in a case tied to his claims about DNA tests on one of the three-fingered bodies found in Peru.
